An Ordinance
further to amend the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 27th July, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 27‑7‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Code
of Civil Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

27-7-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Insertion of new section,
Act V of 1908.---In the Code of Civil procedure, 1908 (Act V of 1908),
hereinafter referred to as the said Code, in Part-V, after section 89, the
following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"89A. Alternate
dispute resolution.---The Court may, where it considers necessary,
having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, with the object of
securing expeditious disposal of a case, in or in relation to a suit, adopt
with the consent of the parties alternate dispute resolution method, including
mediation and conciliation.".

3. Insertion of new rule,
Order X.‑‑‑In the said Code, in Order X, after rule 1,
the following new rule shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"1A The Court may adopt any
lawful procedure not inconsistent with the provisions of this Code to‑‑
(i)
conduct preliminary proceedings and issue orders for expediting processing of the case;
(ii)
issue, with the consent of parties, commission to examine witnesses, admit documents and take other steps for the
purposes of trial;
(iii)
adopt, with the consent of parties, any alternative method of dispute resolution including mediation,
conciliation or any such other means. ".
